definitions.explanation: The act of creating a fake version of something, especially documents, currency, or official items, with the intent to deceive.

examples.japanese: パスポートを{偽造|ぎぞう}する。
{偽造|ぎぞう}{紙幣|しへい}が{見|み}つかった。
{書類|しょるい}の{偽造|ぎぞう}は{重大|じゅうだい}な{犯罪|はんざい}であり、{厳|きび}しく{罰|ばっ}せられる。
examples.english: Forging documents is a serious crime and is severely punished.

notes:
A legal and criminal term. {偽造|ぎぞう} specifically refers to creating something fake from scratch, as opposed to {改竄|かいざん} (tampering with an existing document).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{偽造|ぎぞう}{紙幣|しへい} (counterfeit banknotes)
・{偽造|ぎぞう}パスポート (forged passport)
・{文書|ぶんしょ}{偽造|ぎぞう} (document forgery)
・{偽造|ぎぞう}{品|ひん} (counterfeit goods)
